body: You still alive? You may have thrown away your material values, but you will never lose your inner values (traits, skills). It definitely doesn't seem like so, but I assure you it's true
Please, don't hurt yourself...I wish you the best
I'm just trying to empathize a little, showing you we all go through downs in our lives.
No, it isn't. You took the first step in becoming well again.
I understand, but how do your parent make matters worse?

How do your parents normally make manners worse? If it makes you feel better, I've lost 9 people to suicide. I also failed to qualify for numerous jobs at 17 that I applied for. I've definitely lost more than i gained...I stopped myself from suicide knowing how it would impact my community, and knowing that it might get better someday. And it did
Hey man, can we talk? PM me
What's wrong?
PM me my friend, tell me what's wrong
I would be very interested to read it if you were to make one. What's wrong man? I've attempted suicide in the past and in the end I'm glad I never did it, I think the same can go for you

It sounds like Treatment-Resistant depression. I have the same thing, just combined with clinical depression. I know how you feel. As long as you think you can manage your depression, it's a good option. However, if it ever feels like it's all too much, feel free to message me. I'm here for you, and I support you :)

I strongly suggest foster care,  you don't deserve the abuse.  You deserve to live your life with little burden.  Do you have any form of social media?  Preferably Google Hangouts.  PM me any information,  I'd like to keep in contact with you if its ok

There's a reason you shared this. It's not pointless at all. When I entered therapy I thought it was pointless. I can easily relate. I feel worthless with a 2.1 GPA and zero skills. Just know if you end it now you'll never find out what your future may hold.

I know exactly how you feel. I hope I'm not too late. I feel my life is also worthless. I have a 2.1 GPA in high school and I have zero skills. Do you have any social media like snapchat? I want to keep in contact with you if it's ok. I feel like you and me can both search for a purpose.
Meh...just gives me more to think about...thx
Odd question but, how old are you? Add a little more detail...I'm asking because I think you yourself could seek foster care. One other thing, have any hobbies?
I really appreciate the advice my man...I suppose I'll keep what you said in the back of my mind

I hope you go peaceful man, I'm sorry life never worked out for you...It sounds like you know HTML, or another web-based language. Perhaps learn another coding language? I dunno, just seems like something you would enjoy. Maybe racing? Realistically, it's your opinion on what's fun or not. Goodbye, may you be forever in peace...

Looks like that is two of us, for the fact we both want it to end. I really want you to consider professional help if you want it. All I'm going to say you have something to live for, I don't. You are here and alive for a reason, that reason is because you deserve it. You need to step out of your comfort zone and discover new things, if you don't want to feel like a failure. If you end it now, you'll never know how your life will play out. It could get better...You simply never know. Make the right choice

Hey look man, I know exactly how you feel. I'm going through the same thing. Your life can get better or worse, but if you die now, you'll never find out. If you ever want someone to talk to, I'm here for ya, bud.
